_doc: Worth a Closer Look (Dungeon Alive slice 4, B1): one lore fixture for each subject but maths (maths stays the sword). Stand beside one and press D: ONE question of its subject, binary (flow over gradient). A right answer gives what it has, once; a wrong one spends it all the same (resource loss is the penalty). They give information, consumables, coin and study progress, never gear (the 10-26 loot budget). 'tier' follows the domain (data/domains.json order: the Labyrinth 1 ... the Abyss 5). 'per_floor' [min, max] from 'first_floor' on, never more than 3 questions a floor. 'rooms': the special room it belongs in first; otherwise it stands in an ordinary room. 'reward' is handled in src/game_lore_fixtures.py. A fixture with 'placement': 'boss' is set only by a gate floor's own dressing (data/boss_floors.json 'lore'), never at random.

copyist_desk.subject: grammar
copyist_desk.pass: You find the copyist's slip and set it right, and as the ink takes, the page becomes a scroll.
copyist_desk.fail: Your correction blots across the line, and the page is spoiled.

alchemist_bench.subject: science
alchemist_bench.verb: work out what happened in the retort
alchemist_bench.pass: You see what the alchemist got wrong and finish the work properly, and a potion clears in the flask.
alchemist_bench.fail: The residue fizzes, turns brown and sets hard, and it will never be what it was meant to be.

surveyor_table.subject: geography
surveyor_table.pass: You read the surveyor's marks and finish what he began, until the whole floor lies drawn upon the table and you have it by heart.
surveyor_table.fail: You guess at the marks and smudge the ink, and the map is of no use to anyone now.

memorial_stone.subject: history
memorial_stone.verb: read the names on the stone
memorial_stone.pass: You know these names, or the war in which they died. The last line is no name at all, but tells where they hid their stores.
memorial_stone.fail: The names mean nothing to you, and their bearers remain strangers.

wayside_icon.subject: theology
wayside_icon.pass: You know whose icon this is and what to say to it, and your heart is eased.
wayside_icon.fail: The words will not come, and the candle gutters and goes out.

ledger_desk.subject: economics
ledger_desk.pass: The books do not balance, for someone has been skimming, and you find the missing coin under a false bottom in the drawer.
ledger_desk.fail: The figures swim, for whoever cooked these books was skilled at the work.

trophy_board.subject: animal
trophy_board.pass: You name every trophy on the board, and the hunter's notes beside them teach you more of what hunts this floor.
trophy_board.fail: You cannot say what beasts bore these antlers, tusks and skull.

field_kitchen.subject: cooking
field_kitchen.pass: You know what this stew lacks and you supply it, and it is the best thing that you have eaten in a long while.
field_kitchen.fail: You stir in the wrong thing at the wrong time, and the pot burns black.

brazen_head.subject: ai
brazen_head.pass: It tells you three things about this floor, and you catch the one it made up, whereupon it sulks and tells you something true.
brazen_head.fail: You believe every word, and the head laughs, loud enough to wake the floor.

gamblers_table.subject: trivia
gamblers_table.verb: sit in on the goblins' game
gamblers_table.pass: You know the answer to the question on the last card, and the pot is yours.
gamblers_table.fail: It is the wrong card, and you leave your stake on the table.

riddle_lintel.subject: philosophy
riddle_lintel.pass: You see what the carved question truly asks, and with a grinding of stone a door opens beneath the owl.
riddle_lintel.fail: Your answer is clever but it is wrong, and the owl goes on watching.

brazier_cold.subject: science
brazier_cold.pass: You build the coals as a fire would have them built, and the brazier roars up until the ice round it begins to run.
brazier_cold.fail: The coals smoke sullenly and die, and the kindling is spent.

smoke_vent.subject: theology
smoke_vent.verb: seal the vent with a prayer
smoke_vent.pass: You speak the words over the vent and the smoke stops as though a door had shut, so that nothing more will climb out of that one.
smoke_vent.fail: Your words go up with the smoke, and the smoke does not cease.
